THE ROW JOIN IS BY POSITION, and that is a decision worth stating: the board's
six categories are Buttons / Cards / Sections / Forms / Nav / Footers, and the
code's eleven are the eleven registries (button, card, form, link, badge,
alert, tooltip, modal, nav, table, layout). `Sections` and `Footers` have no
registry at all, so the SET is a code contract — which categories exist is
behaviour, and behaviour is the code's call. What the board settles is the
ROW, and every row on both sides is the same component. So board row N is
joined to code row N and the six measurements are six reads of one shape. The
labels are NOT conformed: singular/plural aside, four of the board's six name
things that do not exist, and 152:112 (`Brand · presets`, another agent's
board, verified `driven`) draws the same list — one board does not get to
rename a control two boards share.
